newsitem.title: USA: Ralcorp sets final ratio for deal.
newsitem.headline: Ralcorp sets final ratio for deal.

text.p: Ralcorp Holdings Inc said Friday it set the final cost basis and ratio for a tax-free transaction involving its branded cereal and snack business.
As part of the tranaction, Ralcorp's branded cereal and snack business was merged with General Mills Inc and the remaining Ralcorp businesses were spun off to shareholders.

Under the deal, for every share of old Ralcorp stock held as of the close of trading on January 31, shareholders of record will receive one share of new Ralcorp stock and 0.163 of a share of General Mills.

On January 31, General Mills completed the purchase of Ralcorp's branded cereal and snack mix businesses in a deal worth $570 million. The purchase price included $355 million in General Mills common stock, or about 5.4 million shares, and the assumption of $215 million of Ralcorp debt by General Mills.
